Output of the commands in `src/checks.rs`.

Captured on a real Fedora machine: `dnf.txt`, `npm-outdated.json`
(`npm outdated --json` in a project; `-g` prints the same shape plus
`current`), `rustup-up-to-date.txt`, `snap-up-to-date.txt` and
`pip-outdated.json` (trimmed to three entries).

Written by hand from each tool's documented output, since the machine had
nothing outdated or no network at the time: `rustup-updates.txt`,
`flatpak-updates.tsv`, `brew-formulae.json`, `brew-casks.json`,
`snap-updates.txt` and the two `softwareupdate-*.txt` (macOS, not run on
any machine yet).
